node.title: XR quotient images route by their global fiber core
node.statement: Across the agreement induction at rates at most 1/4, first-match maximum-agreement quotient slopes have a global key consisting of their rate-preserving scale and k-point full-fiber core. Keys used once have total count at most the existing conservative B_quot_ub(A_0). Every repeated key supplies live slopes sharing a size-k core, hence routes to P-A on the generic branch and to the existing mismatch bridge otherwise. Quotient tails, thresholds, and support counts create no separate multiplicity. [R2 ADDENDUM 2026-08-02: the key core is a SUB-core, so a repeated key certifies a shared core of size >= k; under the partition of record it routes to P-A1 (max core = k) or the band column xr_graded_tangent_band_charge (core >= k+1) on the generic branch — the former '= k' reading was under-inclusive.]
